note: The only placeholders FedDrift documents may contain. Each names an identifier that cannot exist before the external action. code/publish_gate.py allows them at stage pre-deposit and blocks them at stage final.

ZENODO_DOI.meaning: Version DOI minted by Zenodo for FedDrift v0.1.0
ZENODO_DOI.final_action: Zenodo: New upload > Reserve DOI; copy the reserved DOI into tools/fill_placeholders.py --set ZENODO_DOI=10.5281/zenodo.NNNNNNN

ZENODO_CONCEPT_DOI.final_action: shown on the Zenodo record after the first publish; set ZENODO_CONCEPT_DOI

RELEASE_DATE.final_action: set to the day the GitHub release and Zenodo record are published

GITHUB_REPO_URL.final_action: create the repository under the author's account; set GITHUB_REPO_URL=https://github.com/<user>/feddrift

ARXIV_ID.meaning: arXiv identifier of the data descriptor
ARXIV_ID.final_action: after arXiv announces the submission, set ARXIV_ID (only in documents that cite the preprint)
